The window policy summary for window run-intersection separates the legs: business_verdict FAIL and resource_verdict NO_VERDICT, combining to verdict NO_VERDICT. The business FAIL comes from rule overall-errors (operator lte, threshold 0.01) with observed error_rate_ratio numerator 2312 / denominator 37841 in scope overall. The resource leg is a resource_policy_check on metrics-direct/paymentservice-cpu-throttle-ratio (effect sla, operator gt, threshold 0.2) whose status is NO_VERDICT with reason MISSING_RESOURCE_CELLS — that is neither a pass nor a fail. A separate resource_threshold_violation finding records 2 cells from 1790632350000 to 1790632380000 with observed_min 0.39467548476 and observed_max 0.56895862409 ratio; the finding and the NO_VERDICT check status are distinct facts and must not be merged.

Coverage is INCOMPLETE with reasons RESOURCE_GAPS, MISSING_RESOURCE_CELLS and SOURCE_ACQUISITION_PARTIAL. The source summary shows the metrics-direct (prometheus) profile PARTIAL: all three paymentservice queries (cpu, memory, cpu-throttle-ratio) returned PARTIAL with reason MISSING_SAMPLES, while the four frontend and checkoutservice queries and the opensearch errors query returned SUCCESS. Correspondingly, each paymentservice resource summary observed 19 of 23 expected cells with missing_cells 4 and longest_gap_cells 4, while frontend and checkoutservice series show 23 of 23 cells, missing_cells 0 and longest_gap_cells 0.

Error attribution in the evidence: overall scope records error_count 2312 of sample_count 39099; the checkout transaction records the same 2312 of 6515 samples; the other five transactions (add product to cart, cart, home, product, reset cart) each record error_count 0. The opensearch errors evidence returns one group with count 2312, service frontend, error_type frontend.request_error, message "request error", and coverage status COMPLETE with returned_groups 1, sum_other_doc_count 0 and doc_count_error_upper_bound 0. Its timeline has 9 non-zero buckets out of 33 (first_epoch_ms 1790632254832, last_epoch_ms 1790632369669, peak 325 per 15 s / 1300 per minute) with zero counts before and after.

Windows and scopes differ and are not interchangeable: the run window is 1790632187750 to 1790632547764 (360014 ms), the policy evaluation window is 1790632200000 to 1790632545000 (345000 ms, 23 cells at step_ms 15000) after dropping 1 leading cell (12250 ms) and 1 trailing cell (2764 ms), and the errors profile spans 1790632125000 to 1790632620000 (495000 ms), which is why its error_rate_per_minute is 280.242424. The overall-run denominator 39099 and the policy-window denominator 37841 measure different windows.

Critically, resource_binding records clock_alignment "not_verified_by_core". The error timestamps come from opensearch and the metric cells from prometheus, so no lead/lag ordering or causal link between the error burst and the paymentservice throttle finding window is supported by this evidence. No capacity bound, stage outcome, or knee evidence appears in the input. Operator actions available here are limited to verifying clocks, restoring complete paymentservice metric coverage and rerunning, configuring missing policies, and inspecting the referenced error documents and per-cell series values.
